scope: Defender head only, fixed monotonic HGB and existing five-fold OOF isotonic calibration. No changes to midfielder/forward heads, targets, positions, contexts or baseline priors.

arms.ew: Replace Recent5AvgPer90 and Recent5AvgRaw with one RecentEWPer90

ew_definition.clock: Qualifying appearances only, Minutes >=60; cameos neither update nor evict evidence
ew_definition.update: N <- decay*N + actions; E <- decay*E + Minutes/90; rate=N/E; decay=2^(-1/4)
ew_definition.initialization: At a new eligible transfer prior's arrival season, seed N=k*prior_rate and E=k and reset the recent state. Historical appearances before that arrival do not dilute the new recent prior. No prior and no qualifying evidence: fall back to AvgPer90, matching the inference tier. All features precede the target row.
ew_definition.selection: Half-life 4 is fixed before fitting; no search over decay rates in this experiment

development: Chronological splits: train <2022 / validate 2022, train <2023 / validate 2023, train <2024 / validate 2024. Fit every arm identically.
selection: Eligible iff development pooled LL/Brier no worse than baseline by >0.002, AUC no lower by >0.01, no individual year's LL/Brier deterioration >0.010/0.005, zero monotonicity violations, and p95 probability sensitivity to +0.03 StdPer90 at least halved (omitting Std gives exactly zero). Choose lowest pooled LL; among candidates within 0.001 of best choose fewest features, then fixed arm-name order. Write selection.json before any confirmation fits. If none eligible keep baseline.
confirmation: Only the selected candidate is fitted on train<2025 / validate2025 and train<2026 / validate2026. Require LL/Brier no worse than baseline by >0.002 and AUC drop <=0.01 on each split, zero directional violations. Otherwise keep baseline; do not try runner-up or retune on confirmation.

expected.weekly_p95_movement: Combined/lean 10-30% smaller is plausible, not guaranteed or a ship gate
expected.Ajer: Removing Std eliminates the isolated spread reversal; whole weekly rating can still change because of other features and refitting

diagnostics: LL, Brier, AUC, ECE and mean probability per season and pooled
adjacent-appearance changes with fitted model/context/nuisance fixed
current Ajer and Tarkowski ratings and GW7 personal-feature changes
limitations: All these seasons have informed earlier development; retrospective confirmation is not pristine independent evidence
Smooth EW inputs do not guarantee smooth tree/isotonic outputs
Forward study remains immutable, evaluating its originally frozen models only
deployment: If selected candidate passes, preserve a before snapshot, integrate the shared EW computation and selected feature schema in all defender training/inference tiers, run production and check exact experiment agreement and unchanged M/F probabilities. Save an after ratings snapshot. Existing feature mode remains reversible. If rejected preserve incumbent production unchanged.
